name: bizplug-associations
description: The membership associations plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: membership applications and renewals. It works from the business's own published profile, covering membership, events and resources, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
